extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: passenger car tyre, 65 cm diameter, 21.5 cm wide (16 inch rim)
extras.notes: Car tyre without rim, real tread geometry (directional V pattern, shoulder blocks, centre rib, circumferential grooves), sidewall rings and rim protector, two balancing dots (yellow, coral), no lettering. Stands upright, sidewall facing front (-Y). Object origin at the hub centre, so the tyre can roll about the Y axis.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
